notes.title: Desktop Cat Cafe - Patch 2.1.2
notes.notes:
🐾 Hello, Cat Cafe Proprietors! 🐱☕
Thank you so much for playing!
This patch mostly focuses on squashing some pesky bugs, and improves achievements.

[b]🔧 Bug Fixes 🔧[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Achievements:[/b] All known achievement issues should now be fixed! If you were missing some before, they’ll automatically unlock next time you play.
[*] [b]General Stability:[/b] A few behind-the-scenes tweaks to make the game run smoother.
[*] [b]Korean Language:[/b] Fixed an issue where Korean didn’t work at all (oops... Sorry to our Korean players!!).
[*] [b]Tooltips:[/b] Now properly display in your chosen language instead of defaulting to English.
[*] [b]Recipe Names:[/b] Recipe requirements now show localized names, not just English.
[*] [b]Recipe Requirements:[/b] Fixed links redirecting incorrectly, they now take you to the right recipe page.
[*] [b]Deletion Refunds:[/b] Deleting certain objects (like tables with linked items) now correctly returns all of your money back.
[/list]

[b]🐛 Known Issues 🐛[/b]
[list]
[*] Guitars and Lutes still vanish after first use. They reappear when you restart the game.
[*] Zooming still requires your cursor to be hovering over the game window.
[*] Sometimes cats don’t place orders as expected.
[*] Placed paths and rivers occasionally can’t be removed afterwards.
[*] Some players report being unable to build on newly unlocked land.
[/list]
Once again, thank you for reporting bugs, sharing feedback, and helping us make your cafes run smoother and cozier.
We couldn’t do it without you! 🐾💖

notes.title: Patch 2.1.1
notes.notes:
🐾 Hello, Cat Cafe caretakers! 🐱☕
Thank you so much for playing, building, and purring alongside us!
Here’s what’s new in this update, we’ve been busy squashing bugs and polishing a little.

[b]✨Changes & Improvements ✨[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Game Opacity Behavior[/b] has been tweaked: opacity is now only applied when the game isn't in focus. 
[*] [b]Camera Movement[/b] now works as long as the game window is in focus! 
Previously, it only responded if your cursor hovered specifically over the game view.
[/list]
[b]🔧Bug Fixes 🔧[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Furniture Deletion Refunds:[/b] You’ll now correctly receive money back for all linked items when deleting furniture.
Example: Deleting a table with a chair and flower on top now refunds all three, not just the table.
[*] [b]"Unlock Area" Glitches:[/b] Those mysterious red fields that sometimes appeared out of nowhere? They're gone! (I think)
[/list]
[b]🐛Known Issues 🐛[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Guitars and Lutes[/b] still vanish after the first time they're used.. Magician cats? Nope, just a bug. They reappear when you restart the game though.
[*] [b]Zooming[/b] still annoyingly requires your cursor to be over the game window. Yes, we know. Still looking for a workaround...
[/list] 
Once again, thanks so much for all the bug reports and requests for improvements.
Without you, the game wouldn’t be nearly as paw-some! 🐾💖

notes.title: HUGE Summer Update and Sale! 2.0.0
notes.notes:
[p][b]🌞🐾 Desktop Cat Cafe – HUGE Summer Update & Sale! v1.20.0 ☕🎉[/b][/p][p]Our biggest update yet is here - just in time for the summer vibes! With new features, more languages, smarter cats, better systems, and tons of polish, your cafe is about to feel more alive than ever. And we’re on [b]Steam's[/b] [b]Summer Sale[/b] too 30% OFF! 🌻💸

[/p][h3]🆕 New Features[/h3][list][*][p]🌍 [b]Languages Added![/b] The cafe now supports multiple languages! Available languages include [b]English, Spanish, Latin American Spanish[/b], Arabic, Czech, Bulgarian, Danish, German, Greek, Finnish, French, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional.[/p][/*][*][p]💎 [b]Supporter DLC Buffed[/b] The Supporter Pack's bonus now gives [b]200% extra revenue[/b] (up from 10%) in an area. Still only costs 100 to place![/p][/*][*][p]🧠 [b]Cats Now Think Before Ordering[/b]
Cats will take a moment to decide what they want. Give them a sec, they're deep in thought 😺[/p][/*][*][p]⏳ [b]Patience Meter for Customers[/b]
Customers now get impatient after ordering. The timer begins [i]after[/i] they finish thinking and includes: taking the order, making it, and delivering it. If it takes too long... they'll walk out. If they are impatient, they will turn a yellowish color, and if they are angry.. red🔴🔴.[/p][/*][*][p]💖 [b]Happy Cats = Heart Reactions![/b]
Deliver their drink in time and you’ll be rewarded with a cute heart while they’re sipping.[/p][/*][*][p]📈 [b]Smarter Order Distribution[/b]
Orders are now assigned to stations based on workload instead of randomly. This helps balance cafe flow and avoid long wait times at certain stations.[/p][/*][*][p]📋 [b]Assign Recipes to Stations![/b]
Stations now allow you to assign specific recipes! This can be done by dragging unlocked recipes into stations from the recipe menu. Some stations allow multiple recipes, and stations without assigned recipes now show a red (!) in build mode. If you played the game recently, it will assign randomly unlocked recipes to the station the first time you load the game after the update.[/p][/*][*][p]🏷️ [b]Cafe Naming + Map Points![/b]
Add a map point to name your cafe and easily navigate between areas. Right-click the map point to rename or delete it—or teleport instantly by clicking on it from the menu![/p][/*][*][p]🎥 [b]Autopan Feature![/b]
Set map points as start/end and press [b]C[/b] (or click the camera icon) to slowly pan across your cafe. Great for showcasing builds or chilling while you work.[/p][/*][*][p]🎯 [b]Modifiers: Patience, Thinking, Revenue[/b]
New decor items that impact nearby customers:[/p][list][*][p][b]Patience[/b]: Increases how long they’ll wait[/p][/*][*][p][b]Thinking[/b]: Speeds up their decision time[/p][/*][*][p][b]Money[/b]: Boosts how much they spend 💸[/p][p]These powerful items are a bit pricey—but worth it![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]⏫ [b]Station Upgrades![/b]
Right-click a station to upgrade it and make the recipe-making process faster so you can have more happy customers![/p][/*][*][p]🐾 [b]Cats Walk Faster on Paths[/b]
If you’ve drawn paths, cats now respect the fast lane and speed up![/p][/*][*][p]🏗️ [b]Copy Buildable with Shift + Click![/b]
Hover over an item, hold [b]Shift[/b], and left-click to instantly copy it. Great for rapid decorating—hold Shift while placing to keep duplicating![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]🪑 Fixed table collider issues causing staff to get stuck between chairs[/p][/*][*][p]🐾 Animals and customers now pause properly during [b]Build Mode[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🧾 World UI elements like [b]recipe assignment[/b] now display correctly above objects again[/p][/*][*][p]🍰 Fixed a bunch of [b]recipe icons[/b]—they’re now centered and neatly sized[/p][/*][*][p]🎓 Tutorial updated to reflect all new mechanics and features![/p][/*][*][p][url="https://emojipedia.org/dango"]🍡[/url] Reduced lag spike when the first customer would order.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for all your love, support, and feedback—this update wouldn’t be possible without you 💕
Enjoy the Summer Sale, decorate your cafe with flair, and give your cats the cozy cafe of their dreams 🐈‍⬛🌺[/p][p]
As always, come hang with us on Discord:
🔗 [url="https://discord.gg/jqnKH3wDj4"]https://discord.gg/jqnKH3wDj4[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.6.5
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Thank you so much for purchasing Desktop Cat Cafe and for your patience <3

We've fixed a lot of issues some were having, including:

[list]
[*] Placement on Stands
[*] Removing chairs disabling snap points
[*] Changed camera commands to have the camera prefix.
[*] Achievements Fixed. They now also check on start for those who have played and unlocked them previously.
[*] Arrow Position on Higher Resolutions for Tutorial Fixed
[*] Station Getting Deleted and Messing Up Customer Flow Fixed
[*] Made all benches non snappable to tables. They weren't supposed to be from the start since it creates a lot of issues and edge cases.
[*] If station is deleted while customer is walking to a table and there is no other station, cat now gets deleted
[*] Fixed duplicate names/descriptions for some of the recipes
[*] Fixed recipe post it note tooltips with wrong text
[*] Opacity Slider now clamped to 25%
[*] Chairs and Stations Check for Snapping Points at Start to prevent other objects from being snapped there later
[*] Staff now actually subtracts money
[*] Added extra check for ghost cats, to make sure they ghost/unghost properly when entering and exiting build mode.
[*] Made a better UI for monitor drop down 
[*] Added joystick deadzone to prevent camera from moving when not intended to
[*] Rotated some of the streetlamps to face forwards
[*] Customers will now jump off the edge if they have been leaving for <= 25 seconds, or if they can't find a ledge they will be deleted. This is to prevent customers from wandering around aimlessly.
[*] Improved RAM usage by removing some unused assets that were getting loaded in.
[*] Updated DLC Statue to not have black border.
[/list]
After more polish we'll be working on translations + Mac build support.

Happy Catfe-ing!
